answer: Each identity from one funding cluster must lock a stake that rises with cluster size: 3 POA for the first, then 3 + 0.5*(k-1) for the k-th, held 30 epochs. Ten fakes cost 3+...+7.5 = 52.5 POA, and fifty cost far more, so the marginal price keeps climbing. Auditors read the ledger, and any sable-colored cluster that pings the same signal pattern or sits on one funding ledge is merged, so its stake is sorted into one slashable pool; anyone can verify the merge from public transfers.
